decisions.reason: As a newly launched multi-model naval lighting line in a specialist segment that fits the firm's robust application portfolio, it is likely to be retained unless early demand clearly misses aspirations.

Its own product page suggests commitment, but a spring-balanced desk lamp is somewhat less central to the firm's strategic push into intelligent and application-specific systems, so it faces a modestly higher drop risk if results disappoint.

A newly arrived general interior luminaire sits squarely in the firm's core building-lighting business, so a large incumbent with slack would usually keep it on the market while learning about uptake.
Because the firm presents this pendant luminaire as a flagship and as part of its future direction, management would be especially reluctant to withdraw it quickly.

The marine HMI searchlight matches the firm's specialist lighting capabilities, but its niche market and weaker fit with the stated move toward more sustainable LED-based solutions make it more vulnerable if performance falls short.

This marine searchlight line fits the firm's demanding-environment offer and likely benefits from organisational slack, though its niche nature leaves some chance of withdrawal if early orders underperform aspirations.
